$n
「Admit it, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You're still human after all!」

753:t_031:36.en:
$n
「Your belief that 'God' lies beyond humanity is the strongest proof that you're still human!」

753:t_031:37.en:
$n
「If you've really become something beyond human, then show us something beyond our imagination!」

753:t_031:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We have five minutes left! In five minutes, the universe will collapse!」

753:t_031:42.en:
$n
「We'll end this, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We'll end every battle!」

753:t_031:43.en:
$n
「We'll overcome you and win the future with our own hands!!」

753:t_070:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Why?! Why is $$至高神Ｚ$$ trying to grant $$アサキム$$'s wish?!」

753:t_070:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You have abandoned the meaning of life. You cannot become one with $$太極$$... with the Supreme God.」

753:t_070:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The meaning of $$太極$$... In other words, it is... life...」

753:t_070:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「My wish has reached it... All that remains is...」

753:t_070:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Leave it to us, $$アサキム$$! We've received your wish!」

753:t_070:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「To bring an end to everything, we'll grant your wish with our own hands!」

753:t_070:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Don't think mere Earthlings can defeat me!」

753:t_070:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I have surpassed even the $$御使い$$s! Only I can survive the universe's great collapse!」

753:t_070:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「For the first time, you've shown anger from the bottom of your heart.」

753:t_070:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A man who calls himself God has surrendered to his passions.」

753:t_070:10.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Is this... the emotion of $$ドクトリン$$, whom I absorbed...?!」

753:t_070:14.en:
$$甲児$$
「You thought you'd surpassed humanity, surpassed the $$御使い$$s and finally become God!」

753:t_070:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「But you raged at $$ドクトリン$$ for banishing you, mourned your plight, found joy in becoming God and reveled in its power!」

753:t_070:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're doing exactly what humans do, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_070:17.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We can't lose to someone who's neither immortal nor a god!」

753:t_070:18.en:
$$赤木$$
「From here on, it's a fair fight!」

753:t_070:19.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I... am God! I alone can save this universe!」

753:t_070:20.en:
$$レド$$
「Humans aren't gods, and they don't need to become gods!」

753:t_070:21.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If you'd lived alongside us, I'm sure there could have been another path!」

753:t_070:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But you drowned in your power and lost your way!」

753:t_070:23.en:
$$シモン$$
「A guy like that is no god! He's just a villain!」

753:t_070:24.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If you use that power to block the future, I'll overcome you!」

753:t_070:32.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Mere humans have no right to deny me!」

753:t_070:33.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That arrogance is what brings war to the universe!」
